Categories.value: Grimstad church|Self-published work|Sunrises of Norway|Norway photographs taken on 2025-10-13

ImageDescription.value:
Grimstad Church seen from a window on the fifth floor of the Home Hotel in Kirkegata. The photo shows the floodlit church at sunrise on a morning in October 2025.

The church is a cruciform wooden church in Grimstad, Agder County, Norway, designed by architect Henrik Thrap-Meyer and built in 1881. Originally, it had 1,125 seats, making it Norway’s third-largest wooden church.

The church stands on Kirkeheia, 27 meters above sea level — one of five hills surrounding Grimstad’s center — with views of the town and the sea. From the park and viewpoint on Kirkeheia, one can see the town, harbor, Vikkilen bay, the skerries, and the surrounding landscape.
